definitions.explanation: An adult male human. A formal and neutral term for referring to men.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男性|だんせい}⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This company has many male employees.

examples.japanese: {男性|だんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧こちら⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧どうぞ。
{男性|だんせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賃金|ちんぎん}→賃金：04842_chingin⟧⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧
examples.english: The wage gap between men and women

examples.japanese: {男性|だんせい}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{右側|みぎがわ}です。
examples.english: The men's restroom is on the right.

examples.japanese: ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧によると、{男性|だんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧。
examples.english: According to the survey, the average lifespan of men is shorter than that of women.

notes:
{男性|だんせい} is the formal, neutral term for men.

COMPARISON OF TERMS:
- {男性|だんせい}: man (formal, neutral)
- {男|おとこ}: man/male (can sound rough in some contexts)
- {男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}: man (polite, everyday)
- {男|おとこ}の{子|こ}: boy

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男性|だんせい}{社員|しゃいん}: male employee
- {男性|だんせい}{専用|せんよう}: men-only
- {男性|だんせい}{向|む}け: for men
- {成人|せいじん}{男性|だんせい}: adult male

OPPOSITE: {女性|じょせい} (woman, female)
